content: Jon krunavundiŋ kukuyɨ mɨŋaŋgɨrundi hama kuyu ŋgumi
Kandɨhɨvɨ hañɨ Jon kukuyɨ mɨŋaŋgɨruhɨru hama pɨrɨvɨsa Judia, kru manɨman upɨvu umi. Uta krunavundiŋ nɨmavamba kuyu ŋgumi,
Gotɨndu tɨwɨyɨ kɨyɨhɨyɨha arɨñɨndɨ. Harɨm ñamba vanavana ha mitata mavɨŋgimɨrumara, vami.

Got ambahi kru Gotɨndu kuyu mɨŋata ambavaravara Aisaia Jonɨrɨm nɨmavami, Kru manɨman upɨvu kru mumɨŋga kuyu kɨmbañɨ nɨmavɨrɨmandɨ, Aru nɨmarɨm kwɨmbɨ sɨwɨtamata, kwɨmbɨsiki sukɨsɨrambɨ haŋɨnɨŋ mɨŋasɨrɨvamara, vamba ambɨrɨmandɨ, vami.

Jonɨndu mɨkwɨrɨ ha, kamel mɨrɨkwɨyɨ sɨvirɨmu. Kandɨhaŋandɨhin tamata aŋgɨ simbɨyɨ yɨvumɨŋgundi. Aŋgɨ kandɨhaŋandɨhin memendu pɨsayɨ musa mɨŋamu. Jon kandɨhama ñaña sɨkwɨ mañandi. Kapɨrɨmbatɨvat naŋga mɨmɨ mɨkwɨ taya ñandi.
Kandɨhɨrɨvɨ haŋu Jerusalem hati, Judia hati naŋga pɨrɨvɨsa kuku Jordan arɨñɨ kɨrasɨmu haŋɨnɨŋ Jon kɨrasɨmiyɨ parasɨmu.
Kamatɨndɨ ñamba vanavana andɨndu haŋɨnɨŋ ambavarahuhu nurɨŋ Jon, Jordan kukuyɨ mɨŋaŋgɨrundi.

Kamatɨhihi Farisi naŋga Sadyusi muvɨra, utɨrɨŋ arɨŋ kukuyɨ mɨŋaŋgɨrum vata payɨmu. Kamatɨhu nurɨŋ ŋgata nɨmavami, Tau ñambandu ñɨŋi narɨ. Narɨŋ nin ambahi Got narɨŋɨrɨm kɨtɨrɨ kɨta ñamba hɨvɨ ŋgurɨmandɨ nɨŋandɨhinɨrɨm tarahɨrɨmɨndaŋ vata andɨra.
Narɨ mavɨŋgimɨrurɨŋ nzɨkwɨ vataŋgata, muhɨmɨmuhɨm vana andɨtɨra kru muŋɨnɨŋ ŋgamu. Kamata ambɨrɨmandɨyu, Nurɨ mavɨŋgimɨruyu, vamba ambɨrɨmandɨyu.
Narɨŋandɨ indarɨmitɨyɨ, Abraham arɨŋandɨ añɨŋgitak vamba maŋindarɨramamara. Narɨŋ yinda ambin, Got ambɨti tɨmba muŋgɨmuŋgɨ nɨŋɨnɨŋ narɨŋandɨ upɨ mɨŋata Abraham nɨŋuñɨŋgiña yɨvurahahu.
Kahɨri ha ahu tahɨratahɨrarɨm kɨmɨta kɨyɨ. Harɨm ahu sɨhanaŋga kandɨ mandamandu haŋɨnɨŋ tahɨrandahɨra ahumirayɨ kavarɨmandɨyu.

Yi narɨŋ mavɨŋgimɨrumaraŋa vata kukuyɨ mɨŋaŋgɨrundin. Hara kru sɨhɨndɨvu payɨmandɨ hama narɨŋ Gotɨndu Mavɨñɨŋiyɨ naŋga ahumirayɨ mɨŋaŋgɨrumandɨ. Nuŋandɨ tɨkatɨka ha aru sɨkwɨ, yandɨ tɨkatɨka taratɨvɨrandi. Yi avi mɨŋganzɨkwɨ ma, harɨm nuŋandɨ tandambɨsa ha maŋgavuhin.

Nu wit taratara tɨmba ha mɨŋata payɨmandɨ. Kamata wit ha tarandara tɨhuyahɨtiti pipɨrɨmbipɨrɨ ha muvu mɨŋgaramɨti avi haŋɨnɨŋ muvu mɨŋgaramɨti mɨŋata nuŋandɨ huyɨmandavɨyɨ tamɨmandɨyu. Kamata ñambañamba haŋɨnɨŋ ahutuvarandiyɨ kɨrɨrɨmandɨ, vami.
Kandɨtɨwɨmi hañɨ Jisas pɨrɨvɨsa Galili mitata, Jon yaŋ kukuyɨ mɨŋaŋgɨrumandɨ vata kuku Jordan umi.
Hara Jon nuŋ karirahɨrɨman vata nɨmavami, Na yaŋ kukuyɨ mɨŋaŋgɨrunanda avindɨhi. Mumɨndɨhi kɨmbɨnzɨnzɨ yi kɨnɨ nɨñɨ pana, vami.

Kamavahira Jisas kɨmbɨ nuŋ ambami, Kɨndam, tɨhu yi ambin mañandaya andɨ. Nanaŋga kanɨmata vana andɨtanda, Got avi vana sɨhanaŋga andɨmara vata pirɨ kɨndi haŋɨnɨŋ andɨmɨndaŋ, vami. Kamavahi Jon, Jisas ambami maña andɨmi.
Kamavahi Jon, Jisasɨŋ kukuyɨ mɨŋaŋgɨruta mɨtuhi yahami. Kamatɨhi ihunzɨhɨ haŋɨnɨŋ taruvɨhɨrɨhi, Jisas tɨhɨrata yahuta Gotɨndu Mavɨñɨŋi haŋandɨhin ŋgahi kava umari maña nu kɨyɨmiyɨ mɨŋgami.
Kamatɨhi Gotɨndu pɨhu nɨmbu kuyu samur muŋandi nɨmavami, Ñɨŋi nɨŋandɨhin yandɨ mavɨndamandin mɨŋga. Yandɨ mavɨnɨmbu nuŋɨrɨm kɨnzɨhɨnzɨtɨ, vami.

footnotes.text: 3.4 Kru Gotɨndu kuyu mɨŋata ambavaravara hama Elaija mɨkwɨrɨ tamandama, ñaña ñarasɨmi. Jon ndahara mɨkwɨrɨ sɨwɨmaña tamandama ñaña sɨwɨmaña ñarasɨmi. Kuyu kanɨŋandɨhin 2 King 1.8 naŋga, Malakai 4.5 naŋga, Matyu 11.14 naŋga, 17.10-13yɨ ŋgamara.
